claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,310,960 ADA for Hardware Wallet Maintenance 2026.
The budget consists of 1,272,777 ADA for Cardano Hardware Wallet Maintenance & Compatibility Assurance and a 38,183 ADA Intersect Budget Administration fee.

The requested work covers 12 months of production maintenance for Ledger and Trezor compatibility, supporting libraries, cardano-hw-cli, developer support, integration support, and vendor-required audits.

The proposal asserts that continuous maintenance is needed because Cardano protocol evolution, vendor firmware and app release cycles, and wallet and dApp integration demand create compatibility risk at the hardware-wallet access layer.

The proposal states that the scope is limited to compatibility, security, supporting libraries/tooling, release support, and vendor-required audit work and does not duplicate broader core-node, ledger, or general infrastructure maintenance budgets.

The proposal states that it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides references to voting results, documentation, and audit materials.

The proposal claims the withdrawal does not, at submission time, alone or in aggregate, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713, and links to the governance action for that limit.

Intersect will administer funds through a Sundae Labs treasury management smart contract framework using one Treasury Reserve Smart Contract and one Project-Specific Smart Contract, with specified stake and payment addresses.

The proposed oversight model requires combinations of Intersect admins, Intersect leadership, and external Oversight Committee members from Sundae Labs, Cardano Foundation, Dquadrant, NMKR, Sundial, and Eternl for key treasury-contract actions.

The proposal discloses prior related treasury and Catalyst funding references for hardware-wallet maintenance, Ledger app rewrite, Ledger Live integration, message signing, and other security or developer ecosystem work.

summary: The document describes a 1,310,960 ADA treasury withdrawal submitted by Intersect for 12 months of Cardano hardware-wallet maintenance, with a detailed budget split, scope, smart-contract administration structure, oversight permissions, NCL compliance assertion, and external references for voting, audits, contracts, and prior related funding.
